subject: Next steps: vectorstore cutover & rerank acceptance criteria
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: vectorstore cutover & rerank acceptance criteria

Hi Emily —

Great speaking last week. Per our call I pulled together a concise implementation checklist so Nimbus can plan the cutover window with SRE and Product. High level asks below; attached is a short implementation plan and a small sample index (index-sample.csv) for your engineers to validate ingest format.

Key milestones (proposal):
- Week 0: Access + test dataset ingest (small sample)
- Week 1: Bulk backfill run (nightly window) + monitoring hooks
- Week 2: Rerank smoke tests against production queries (A/B)
- Week 3: Production cutover with 30% traffic, rollback gating

Acceptance criteria for rerank:
- NDCG@10 improvement >= 6% on prioritized query set OR no more than 3% regression in click-through on control set
- Latency p95 for combined search+rerank <= 220ms in the us-west region

Can you confirm the proposed window and whether your team needs a pre-signed S3 ingest or direct DB transfer?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: nimbus-implementation-plan.pdf, index-sample.csv
From: Emily Park <emily.park@nimbushealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Nimbus ML Team <nimbus-ml@health.nimbus.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vectorstore cutover & rerank acceptance criteria

Thanks Ben —

This looks good. Quick answers: we prefer pre-signed S3 for the bulk backfill. Our infra lead (copied on the alias) will open up an ingest window; target start is Thurs 24 Jun for the small ingest and the bulk run can follow the week after.

A couple of questions from Product:
- Can you share the exact query set you'll use for the NDCG measurement? We want to make sure the set reflects our clinical search patterns.
- For p95 latency, is the 220ms SLA measured end-to-end (our app -> Redwood) or just the Redwood serving leg?

Emily
Emily Park
Product Manager, Nimbus Health
emily.park@nimbushealth.com
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@nimbushealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vectorstore cutover & rerank acceptance criteria

Emily —

Ben looped me in to confirm the backfill mechanics. Quick technical notes:
- We can provide the NDCG query set as a CSV (we usually use 500 queries for an initial smoke-run). We'll include per-query relevance labels and traffic priors.
- The p95 threshold I quoted is for the Redwood serving leg (time from request arrival at Redwood API to final response). If you need an end-to-end SLO we can run synthetic checks from your app endpoints during the cutover and add an additional 60-80ms budget depending on network egress.

Operationally: for the bulk backfill we recommend using multi-part S3 uploads with our ingest manifest file (we'll supply manifest template). Backfill will run using parallel workers and we will stream partial indexing stats to the shared Drive folder so your SRE can watch progress.

Two items for you to confirm:
1) Do you require us to perform the initial seed in a staging index that you already have, or should Redwood provision a temporary vectorstore instance for the smoke tests?
2) Any regulatory constraints on storing embeddings for more than 90 days? If yes, we can enable ephemeral caching only.

- Mina
Mina Haddad
Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com
From: Emily Park <emily.park@nimbushealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Nimbus ML Team <nimbus-ml@health.nimbus.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vectorstore cutover & rerank acceptance criteria

Thanks Mina —

Answers:
1) Please provision a temporary vectorstore instance for the smoke tests; we want to avoid impacting our current staging indexes.
2) We cannot retain embeddings for longer than 180 days without an additional security review. 90 days is preferable but 180 days is the max approved for now.

About the query set: we'll export a sample clinical query set and share it in the Drive folder you linked (I will upload by Wednesday EOD). For the latency SLO, Product wants the end-to-end p95 so please include your serving leg number and we will add network overhead.

Also, small ask on rerank eval metrics: can Redwood provide per-query deltas (NDCG change, reciprocal rank delta) and an aggregate table that we can drop into our dashboards?

Emily
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: vectorstore cutover & rerank acceptance criteria

Emily —

Great — thanks for the clarifications. Action items updated below and I've included the shared Drive link and attachments for the manifest and sample metrics workbook.

Action items (owners & dates):
- Emily / Nimbus: upload clinical query sample to Drive (Wed 2027-06-16 EOD) — Emily
- Redwood: provision temporary vectorstore for smoke tests (Thu 2027-06-17) — Mina
- Redwood: provide ingest manifest and pre-signed S3 template (Thu 2027-06-17) — Ben
- Nimbus: confirm retention policy (90 vs 180 days) after security review (Fri 2027-06-18) — Emily
- Redwood: run 500-query NDCG smoke-run and produce per-query delta CSV + aggregate XLSX (Week of 2027-06-21) — Mina

We will not start any bulk backfill until the smoke-run meets the acceptance criteria or we mutually agree to a rollback gating. If helpful, we can set up a 30-minute sync Thursday morning to walk the team through the manifest template and the rerank metrics workbook.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: rerank-eval-metrics.xlsx, nimbus-implementation-plan.pdf
